history.notes: Every number from the generator (pinned AS_OF 2026-11-14, seeded sims; byte-identical rerun). Schedule from the new raw_nhl_schedule (84-game season, divisions derived from it); playoff format assumed unchanged and said so. Backtest 2023-26 at the 20-game mark vs in-spot baseline, low-bucket calibration and last year's Sabres (13%, made it) disclosed. Record vs chances-worth points (20.7 vs 20) and carry-over (first 20 games vs rest) computed. Ledger P0017 logged on Charlie's go before the next game; story asserts p matches. Fixed: unsupported '0.2 is where they've been' claim, PK wording (mixes penalty count and kill quality), chart title overclaim, hardcoded record numbers. No betting words; jargon only in stat-heads; charts opened.
